title: AI and Roms
author: r0b0c0p87
selftext:
Hey, all, I've been messing with Astra for a few days now, just trying to cut through the hype and see what it's actually capable of.

Well, I have a lot of roms. I just gave Astra access to my roms folder and it is going nuts. It managed to find a version of Shadows of the Empire that can run on Windows with no emulator needed. It then updated the controls to be in line with modern FPS's and is currently extracting and updating the graphics for the Hoth level.

I haven't tested yet, but it claims it can do just about anything I want it to do to my roms. New jobs in Final Fantasy Tactics? Easy. Better graphics for Burnout Takedown and maybe some new cars? No problem. Randomized item locations in Link to the Past? Just say the word. Based on what it's done on Shadows of the Empire, I am inclided to believe those claims, though I still plan to test them.

So far, I am absolutely blown away. I'm still tweaking some stuff but will post screenshots later. About to replace Dash Rendar with Boba Fett as the playable character.
